title: Small and lightweight
text: Small and lightweight. I wanted something sturdy and large enough for people with real hands.  The forks are smaller than they should be, and I can't rate durability since I've only had them a couple of months.  I can't rate surdiness for the same reason.  Disappointed.  It'll do the job, but feels cheap.  Disappointing for Oneida.

product_metadata.title: Oneida Paul Revere Fine Flatware Place Spoon, 0.10 LB
features: Premium quality 18/10 stainless steel. Highest level of rust resistance available.
Satin finish softens the shine and promises to stay smooth.
Product backed by a limited lifetime warranty and is dishwasher safe.
description: The bold Paul Revere Place Spoon features an artistic, flat base that narrows into a tastefully subtle spire-like design at the top of the handle. Scoop up something savory or sweet.

The world's largest manufacturer of stainless-steel and silver-plated flatware, Oneida also produces dinnerware, crystal stemware, glassware, serveware, and kitchen tools. Lacking any adornment, the smooth handle of this versatile Paul Revere place spoon coordinates with a variety of occasions and is perfect for every day use. With a squared off edge and straight sides, the collection has a solid, dependable sensibility that matches a range of table dressings. Crafted from 18/8 stainless steel, the 18 percent chromium aids in corrosion resistance and the 8 percent nickel increases luster and shine. Dishwasher-safe, the flatware qualifies for Oneida's lifetime warranty program.
